messages:
lina-peopleops: Quick heads-up — Arjun submitted an ADA accommodation intake this morning (private). Manager raised a parallel performance concern around missed sprint commitments. Looking to coordinate next steps without sharing sensitive details in-channel. Can @tia-manager, @sam-peopleops, and @omar-engineering join a quick sync?

tia-manager: Thanks Lina. I saw the intake form but haven't read medical details. High-level: two missed deadlines last cycle + a tense 1:1. I want to support Arjun but also need to flag deliverables. Can we do a private huddle and agree temporary adjustments before we talk to Arjun?

arjun-ic: Hi — appreciate the heads-up. I filed the intake because my anxiety spikes when I'm scheduled for late shift/on-call and it affected my focus. Happy to meet privately. Please keep any medical stuff out of team threads.

sam-peopleops: Received. I'll take the intake into PeopleOps intake queue and assign an ADA coordinator. Suggest temporary measures: 1) cover late-shift on-call for two weeks, 2) shift meeting times earlier, 3) reduced async task load while we evaluate. Are these reasonable?

omar-engineering: I can take on on-call for the next two rotations. No prob. Will coordinate handover with Arjun tonight at 6pm.

tia-manager: That helps. For deliverables, can we triage Arjun's open tasks and reassign any high-priority blockers? I want to avoid a perf improvement plan if we can adjust workload and support first.

lina-peopleops: Agreed. Action items: Sam to start ADA coordinator intake + timeline, Omar to cover on-call, Tia to prepare a task triage list, Lina to schedule a private sync (people ops + manager + IC). We'll avoid discussing diagnosis; stick to functional accommodation requests. ETA: meet today 3pm PT?

sam-peopleops: ADA intake queued, coordinator assigned, and confidential doc placeholder created. I posted an automated receipt: `hr-bot: ADA intake received for user arjun-ic — case #A-1930001111` (private link shared via DM).

hr-bot: [automated] ADA intake A-1930001111 created. Coordinator: sam-peopleops. Next step: intake call within 3 business days. Do not share medical attachments in public channels.

tia-manager: 3pm PT works for me. I'll export a short task list and share via DM to Lina so we can reassign before our meeting.

arjun-ic: Thank you everyone. Appreciate keeping this private and the on-call cover. I can meet at 3pm.

lina-peopleops: Meeting invite sent to Tia/Sam/Arjun/Omar. Notes after call will be posted only in PeopleOps case file. I'll mark this thread as private. :small_blue_diamond: Please avoid replies with medical details here.
